technology_name: Trichoderma harzianum (CPTD28) Coir Pith Cake Technology
problem_solved: Need for prophylactic treatment against bud rot and management of stem canker and soil-borne diseases.
description: A simple and low-cost technology for producing Trichoderma coir pith cakes with a shelf life of one year. The formulation is very easy to handle and apply in the crowns of coconut palms as a prophylactic treatment against bud rot, in the management of stem canker of cocoa, and also for the management of soil-borne diseases in potted plants.
applications: Manufacturing of organic agricultural biocontrol agents, Production of prophylactic treatments for plantation crops, Commercial nursery disease management
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
